FN-UYEYGGG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 55
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Ron Bolton
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/12/2024
House Bill 55 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and county
general funds, by an undetermined amount, depending on the number of violations issued and
the penalties imposed. In addition, a third or subsequent conviction also result in two point
violation on the individuals driving record.
